home.title: Report your neighborhood
home.lead: Post a case with a photo and location, support your neighbors’ reports and follow their progress. The most urgent cases are handled first.
home.mapaAria: Interactive map with the published cases
home.mapaAyuda: Click a marker to see a summary of the case. Below you will find the same cases as a list.
home.vacio: No cases match those filters. Try other filters or press “Clear”.

login.title: Log in · Report your neighborhood
login.ayuda: Use your email and password. The same login is used by citizens and staff.
reg.title: Create account · Report your neighborhood
reg.ayuda: With your account you can post cases and support your neighbors’ reports.
reg.privacidad: We use your email only to identify you on the platform.
pub.title: Post a case · Report your neighborhood
pub.intro: Tell us what is happening, upload a photo and mark the place on the map. All fields are required.
pub.phDescripcion: For example: large pothole in front of the shop, it has already caused two falls
pub.phReferencia: In front of the corner shop
pub.mapaAyuda: Click on the map to place the marker. You can drag it to adjust the point. If you do not use the map, the neighborhood and the landmark are enough: the case will be placed at the city center.
pub.mapaAria: Map to mark the place of the problem
det.title: Case details · Report your neighborhood
det.mapaAria: Map with the location of the case
det.prioridadAyuda: Priority combines the severity of the type of problem, the support from neighbors and the number of days the case has been unresolved.
mis.title: My cases · Report your neighborhood
mis.vacio: You haven’t posted any cases yet.
mis.caption: Cases posted by you
panel.title: Management panel · Report your neighborhood
panel.intro: Cases appear from highest to lowest priority. Priority combines the type of problem, the support from neighbors and the days unresolved.
panel.caption: Cases sorted by priority
est.title: Statistics · Report your neighborhood
est.soloImpresion: Report your neighborhood · Cases by neighborhood report

est.caption: Cases by neighborhood and status, not counting rejected ones
est.nota: Rejected cases are not counted. “Pending” includes received cases and cases under review.
